title: Register a domain name for your business
summary: Learn about registering a domain name to establish an online presence for your business.
intro:
Your domain name is your website address on the internet. It gives you an online presence, and is an important marketing tool that can help customers find your business. If you don’t yet have a website, you can register your domain name and keep it until you’re ready.
